sloka: शूर्श्च कृतविद्यश्च जितक्रोधः क्षमापरः ।कथं कमलपत्राक्षो मया रामो विवास्यते ॥२-१३-९॥
transliteration: śūrśca kṛtavidyaśca jitakrodhaḥ kṣamāparaḥ ।kathaṁ kamalapatrākṣo mayā rāmo vivāsyate ॥2-13-9॥

translations.english: How can I exile Rama, whose eyes resemble lotus petals, who is learned, who has subdued his anger and who is always full of forgiveness?
